split.excluded: rejected historical invoices; lines without a GL account
leakage_controls: split by invoice date (no invoice spans both folds)
TF-IDF/one-hot fitted inside the pipeline on the training fold only
no target-derived features; vendor default GL comes from vendor master

text_only_model_all_test_lines.note: cold-start proxy: vendor features withheld for every line

cold_start_leave_one_vendor_out.note: Each test supplier's lines scored by a text-only model trained without that supplier. In production unseen suppliers are always human-reviewed; this measures suggestion quality.

caveats: Synthetic dataset; GL codes are highly predictable from the vendor, so vendor baselines are strong.
Recurring invoices repeat descriptions across months; see novel_description_lines for unseen text.
Unseen suppliers are always routed to human review regardless of model confidence.
